scenes.text: One shot. To this day nobody living or dead can name whose finger. Daddy said it didn't matter none. Two thousand men had already fired it in their minds. That bullet was just catching up.

scenes.text: And white Tulsa went shopping. Smashed into pawnshops and hardware stores and armed itself on credit it never meant to settle. Robbed their own town to come kill ours. Then wrote us down as the riot.
